observations: Black with faint tonal damask, fine gold hem edge and black/gold striped cuffs. The first archive thumbnail is poor; an independently observed close-up on the same detail page resolves the print, with another gallery image confirming collar/cuff colors. Source crop URL is saved in additional/sources.json. Discrete constant-color ink from clean crop [373,575,300,330], sampled 300px and repeated at 65 × 71.5 internal units; hidden print placement is adapted. No source fabric/photo pixels are embedded. Colors are visual estimates. Common-silhouette adaptation preserves the original PNG fabric/alpha and physical round collar.
omitted: Emblems, logos, sponsors and lettering. Original PNG collar construction retained.
